fec_alponte26.t: ALPONTE, MONICA MARIA (H6AZ01488), 2025–2026 — FEC candidate page (accessed 2026-10-08)

gp_alponte.t: Monica Alponte — GoodParty.org candidate profile, U.S. House AZ-1 (accessed 2026-10-08)

links.site_note: URL listed on her GoodParty.org profile; the site itself could not be opened (provenance block). X: x.com/MonicaAlponteAZ.

oneliner.t: Libertarian nominee for AZ-01 and first-time federal candidate who describes herself as a retired business writer, former political talk-show co-host and stock investor; her campaign reported $8,941 raised through July 1, 2026.

upbringing.t: Says she was raised in a military family, lived across the country, and has made Arizona home for about 25 years. She lists local work on road safety, animal rescue and HOA reform. These are her own accounts and are not independently documented.

career.role: Business writer (retired); former political talk-show co-host; stock investor (self-described)

platform.t: Foreign policy: non-interventionist; says ending 'endless foreign wars' is the top solution to the national debt.
Immigration: secure the border and end incentives for illegal immigration.
Government: rein in government; calls HOAs 'microcosms of our broken government.' Supports property rights and parental rights.
Speech: free speech for all, including speech she disagrees with.
Spending: balance the budget, cut bureaucratic waste, and oppose projects like 'golden ballrooms.'
Animal welfare: supports compassionate animal stewardship.

promises.t: Always vote for non-intervention and peace.
Refuse money from AIPAC and foreign lobbies.

claims.claim: Has made Arizona home for about 25 years.
Retired business writer and former political talk-show co-host.

record.t: No independent record found; the show is not named.

claims.claim: Ending endless foreign wars is the #1 solution to the national debt.

record.t: A policy judgment, not a checkable fact.

said.t: Will refuse money from AIPAC and foreign lobbies.

did.t: FEC shows $0 from any PAC or party committee; receipts were $7,285 from individuals plus $1,656.37 of her own money and loans.

aipac_endorse.t: Not checked (AIPAC's portal not opened); she pledges to refuse AIPAC money.

aipac_pac.note: 2026 cycle: FEC shows $0 in committee contributions through 2026-07-01

statements.t: Pledges to refuse AIPAC and foreign-lobby money and to vote for non-intervention.

fec.src_note: self = $285.16 in contributions plus $1,371.21 in candidate loans; $871.21 of the loans is still owed.

note.t: No House financial disclosure was located; none was searched for by name. Her profile lists her occupation as 'Stock Investor.'
About 25 years in Arizona, by her own account.

checks.claims: Her campaign site could not be opened. Sample = every checkable claim on her GoodParty.org profile (campaign-supplied text). Only 3 checkable claims, all unverifiable, plus 1 opinion. Fewer than 5 exist in the material reachable. No ads found.

research_notes: Thin record, as expected for a minor-party candidate. Everything biographical is self-reported. az-races.json says she was unopposed in the Libertarian primary. GoodParty.org does not state her party, but FEC and az-races list her as Libertarian. FEC coverage starts 2026-01-01; no prior federal cycles are listed.
